peer.hint: Bring two devices in line using QR codes, no account or cloud needed.
peer.title: Sync
peer.intro: Open this screen on both devices. One device shows a code, the other scans it. Then they exchange everything and end up with the same notes.
peer.offlineHint: You're offline. Syncing works best when both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.
peer.hostHint: Choose this on the device with the biggest screen, e.g. the laptop.
peer.joinHint: Choose this on the device with a rear camera, e.g. the phone.
peer.privacy: The devices connect directly. To find each other they use a public service (STUN) that only sees IP addresses, never your notes.
peer.cameraWhy: PlaceLog may ask for the camera: it is needed for scanning and helps the devices find each other on the Wi-Fi network.
peer.step1Host: Scan this code with the other device (choose "Scan code" there).
peer.nextScanAnswer: Scanned? Now scan the reply code
peer.step2Host: Point the camera at the reply code on the other device.
peer.step1Join: Point the camera at the code on the other device.
peer.step2Join: On the other device, tap "Now scan the reply code" and let it scan this code.
peer.doneHint: The other device now also has everything from this device.
peer.cameraDenied: No camera access. Allow the camera in the browser, or paste the code below.
peer.cameraNone: No camera found. Let the other device share the code as text and paste it below.
peer.badCode: This is not a valid code for this step.
peer.error.badCode: The code could not be read. Please try again.
peer.error.wrongStep: This code belongs to the wrong step. Choose "Show code" on one device and "Scan code" on the other.
peer.error.noConnection: Couldn't connect. Are both devices on the same Wi-Fi network? Some networks (guest or work Wi-Fi) block direct connections.
peer.error.newerVersion: The other device has a newer version of PlaceLog. Update this app first (close and reopen it).
peer.error.notPlekboek: The other device sent unknown data.
peer.error.closed: The connection was lost. Please try again.
peer.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
install.title: Install app
install.banner: Install PlaceLog for quick access and offline use.
install.hint: Put PlaceLog on your home screen or in the Start menu. It then also works offline in its own window.
install.iosTitle: Add PlaceLog to your Home Screen
install.iosWarning: Note: Safari and the installed app keep their data separately. So install before you create notes.
